nodes.speaker: Signpost
nodes.text: Welcome, traveler! This sign will teach you the basics.

nodes.speaker: Signpost
text: WASD or Arrow Keys - Move around the world
SPACE or ENTER - Talk to NPCs and interact with objects
ENTER near a door - Go inside buildings

nodes.speaker: Signpost
text: Talk to the NPCs around town. Claude, the orange one, knows a lot about this place.
Not all doors lead somewhere yet. More buildings are coming soon!
